motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. Every leaf, every stem and every branch is copied from the first frame exactly: not one of them moves, bends, shifts, grows or changes shape or colour at any point. Frames 1, 2 and 5 are identical to each other. Only frames 3 and 4 differ at all, and only by a handful of pixels. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel. The last frame matches the first exactly.
